name: test-writer
description: Write tests that verify behavior (not implementation), use table-driven/parameterized patterns, and minimize mocking. Supports Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, and Rust.

interface.longDescription: Writes tests that check behavior instead of implementation, uses table-driven patterns when cases share one assertion shape, mocks only external boundaries, and reviews existing tests for 10 common anti-patterns. Supports Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, and Rust.
defaultPrompt: Use $test-writer to add behavior-first tests for src/parser.go.
Use $test-writer to review tests/parser_test.go for anti-patterns.
Use $test-writer to write table-driven tests for this Python module.
